unit: pct of demand income per tick

what_cooperation_consists_of.tech_handoff: native objective = the mechanism's own score: every seat is credited half of the facility's revenue minus half of all costs (the joint outcome). Ablation: each seat is trained on its own net only (half the revenue minus its own costs); nothing else changes (same observations, same money flows, same seeds).
what_cooperation_consists_of.abm_complement: native objective = own net (own price x bundles sold minus own cost). The reverse ablation adds the cooperative channel: each seat is trained on the mean of both nets. In both families no money moves between seats and no observation changes.

value_delivered.what: jobs completed while still wanted, per match
